toni_r: FYI ran int4 + adaptive-batching canary for eirene-15b overnight. seeing two classes of failures: OOMs on long multi-turn (>1000 tokens) and p99 spikes when batch coalescing happens.
esther: how often are the OOMs?
toni_r: ~0.6% of requests at 2am-4am window, correlates with bursty multi-turn traffic from a partner. p99 jump to 520ms vs baseline 320ms.
ivan_m: any traceback? kernel or nvml?
toni_r: nvml shows fragmentation pattern: repeated small KV frees, then large alloc for new KV fails (cudaOOM). runtime logs show batch merge triggers a large combined KV alloc that exceeds remaining contiguous slot.
esther: did you try reducing adaptive batch max_size or disabling coalescing?
toni_r: tested three variants:
A) baseline adaptive: max_batch=64, coalesce=true -> OOMs 0.6%, p99 520ms
B) adaptive w/ coalesce=false -> OOMs 0.05%, p99 430ms (worse than baseline latency but stable)
C) adaptive + coalesce=true + soft_kv_limit=0.9 -> OOMs 0.1%, p99 340ms (best tradeoff)
ivan_m: soft_kv_limit = 0.9 * slot_capacity makes sense. any impact on throughput?
toni_r: throughput -4% in C vs A, cost per tok +2%.
esther: quality checks? truncation or generation diffs?
toni_r: ran 100 eval prompts with long summaries and multi-turn q&a. no measurable quality regressions in top-5 metrics; small increase in generation latency jitter when eviction happens.
ivan_m: could also try compacting KV slots periodically to reduce fragmentation. have we enabled slot_compactor on canary?
toni_r: not yet. added plan to enable low-priority compaction every 20s and shrink slot-reserve from 8 -> 6 for canary nodes.
sre-bot: Note: change requests must include perf regression dashboard and rollback time window.
esther: propose canary defaults: max_new_tokens: 900, adaptive.max_batch: 48, coalesce: true, soft_kv_limit: 0.9, slot_compactor: interval=20s, slot_reserve=6. if we still see OOMs, fall back to coalesce=false.
toni_r: config snippet: ``` model_defaults: { max_new_tokens: 900, batching: { adaptive: true, max_batch: 48, coalesce: true }, memory: { soft_kv_limit: 0.9, slot_compactor: { enabled: true, interval_s: 20 }, slot_reserve: 6 } } ```
ivan_m: add a synthetic test that spawns multi-turn sessions with max_new_tokens=1200 and varying inter-arrival times to verify eviction + compactor. also add nightly eval comparing 200 prompts vs fp16 baseline.
esther: agreed. rollout checklist:
- [ ] push canary defaults
- [ ] enable slot_compactor with low CPU priority
- [ ] add synthetic multi-turn stress test to CI
- [ ] enable perf dashboards (p95/p99, oom-rate, tokens/s)
- [ ] run 48h canary and review
toni_r: I'll open a PR and attach bench logs. leaving canary on until Friday for 48h window. ping here when metrics look good.
sre-bot: Deploy recorded: eirene-15b canary patch #5127 scheduled 03:30 UTC.
esther: thanks team :thumbsup: keep an eye on partner bursts and we can bump max_new_tokens later if compactor behaves.
ivan_m: if compactor isn't enough, runtime to investigate aligned-int4-kernel allocations to reduce fragmentation next quarter.
toni_r: noted. followup with 48h report in thread. :eyes:
